exact: mRNA binding involved in post-transcriptional gene silencing
narrow: translational inhibitor activity via mRNA base-pairing
related: mRNA binding involved in posttranscriptional gene silencing

definition: A post-transcriptional repressor activity that acts by base-pairing with an mRNA to prevent gene expression. The binding can result in targeting the mRNA for degradation or interfering with mRNA translation resulting in post-transcriptional gene silencing.
label: mRNA base-pairing post-transcriptional repressor activity
